SAMUEL SUPPORTS BOYCOTT!!

Huse: You fool, how are we supposed to earn money?
SAMUEL: It's a public decision who will hold the money!
Huse: What if the public doesn't choose us? You cannot buy cs:go anymore!
SAMUEL: We will respect the public! I can live without cs:go...
Huse: No dude, democracy is overrated as f. However, you inspired me. I want to contribute to you. How can I help?
SAMUEL: Don't buy anything! It's simple as that.
Huse: Ok, I think I can do that at least.
